headline: US strikes Iranian Revolutionary Guard after attack kills US troops in Jordan
story: The US military carried out airstrikes against the Iranian Revolutionary Guard after an attack on a base in Jordan killed two US service members, left one missing and injured four others. The action further widens the conflict around the Strait of Hormuz.
keywords: US-Iran conflict | Jordan | Revolutionary Guard | Strait of Hormuz
